name: sure
description: The personal finance app for everyone (by everyone)
one_liner: A free, self-hosted alternative to apps like Mint or YNAB that tracks your spending, net worth, and cash flow, with an AI assistant you can ask questions like 'how much did I spend on dining out?'
buyer: A privacy-conscious household or small financial advisory practice that wants a Mint-style budgeting app without handing their bank data to a third-party cloud company.
business_use_cases: A financial advisor self-hosts it for clients and charges a 'managed dashboard' fee instead of clients paying for a commercial app subscription.
A privacy-focused hosting company offers 'Sure, hosted for you' as a managed service for people who want the app without running a server themselves.
A personal finance coach uses the shared dashboard view as the centerpiece of a paid coaching program, reviewing a client's real numbers together live.

money_ideas.idea: Managed hosting: run and maintain the app for non-technical users who don't want to self-host
Done-for-you setup and bank-sync configuration service

steal_this: Host it for five friends or family members this weekend, charge a small monthly fee for upkeep and support, and you have a tiny recurring-revenue micro-business.
